PROP-aa9e39fd-inv-004.text: Every transaction in a valid block must have gasLimit <= 16777216.
PROP-aa9e39fd-inv-004.assertion: forall block B accepted: forall tx in B.transactions: tx.gasLimit <= 16777216

code_scope.resolution_error: Searched for: 16777216, 0x1000000, TX_MAX_GAS, GAS_CAP in block validation code. No per-transaction gas cap found. Only block-level gas accounting exists (eth/block.rs:111-119 checks tx.gas_limit <= block.gas_limit - gas_used), which is insufficient for EIP-7825 enforcement.
